These optimizations yield significant speedups, such as 5.5x and 3.9x faster DGEMM on specific NVIDIA GPUs. Applications like CCSD quantum chemistry and BerkeleyGW materials science simulations show substantial end-to-end performance gains. The work also details the mathematical basis and practical performance of these methods across various hardware.

This concept was integrated into the Transformer architecture, leading to modern LLMs like Mistral and GPT-4, and models such as Mixtral 8x7B. These models demonstrate efficiency by only activating a subset of experts for specific computations.

items.title: Test-Time Training – A Model That Changes While You Use It
items.summary: Test-time training (TTT) is an ML technique that allows a model to continue learning and adapting while it is being used for inference. It achieves this by creating a self-supervised auxiliary task from new test data, using the model's errors on this task to update some of its parameters. This process blurs the line between training and inference, enabling models to adjust to new conditions during real-world use. TTT is particularly beneficial for world models that need to rapidly adapt to changing states and environments. However, limitations exist, as poor learning signals can cause overfitting or performance degradation.
